issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size buffers any bytes payload as PCM, no gating or validation
issues.detail: _write_frame slices every bytes payload into packet_bytes chunks regardless of frame type or sample width. Non-audio binary serializers get corrupted, and a non-multiple-of-sample-width value silently produces broken PCM. Gate on AudioRawFrame and assert packet_bytes aligns with sample width at setup.

issues.description: Packetization path lacks terminal flush and does not actually pace
issues.detail: The while-loop emits full packets back-to-back without touching _next_send_time, despite the PR description promising real-time pacing. The trailing remainder also sits in _audio_send_buffer forever with no end-of-stream flush, so final short segments are dropped. Either implement pacing and a flush, or rename to fixed_audio_packet_size as framing-only.

issues.description: Resampler tail/state not flushed or reset on stream end or interruption
issues.detail: serialize and deserialize discard zero-length resampler output but never flush a stateful resampler at StopFrame, so trailing audio is lost. On InterruptionFrame the byte buffer is cleared but resampler filter history is not, producing artifacts on the next utterance. Document that the resampler is stateless or wire explicit flush/reset.

issues.description: PCM16 contract asserted in comments but never enforced
issues.detail: Comments in serialize/deserialize claim 16-bit linear PCM, but nothing checks frame.format or sample width. Upstream 8-bit or float audio would be resampled as garbage and shipped. A one-line assert or check beats a comment.

issues.description: DTMF digit parsing accepts two undocumented payload shapes
issues.detail: deserialize tries message['digit'] then message['dtmf']['digit'] with no citation of which is canonical Vonage format. Defensive coding around an unknown shape hides protocol drift and survives forever. Pin the documented shape, parse that, and log-and-drop the other.

issues.description: Rename from audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: The param sits on a public dataclass and defaults to None, so existing users of audio_packet_bytes lose packetization silently with no error. Either keep a deprecated alias for one release or call this out loudly as breaking in the changelog.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The Vonage serializer is roughly the right shape but under-specified: PCM16 is asserted only in comments, DTMF parsing guesses between two payload shapes, and the resampler has no tail flush or interruption reset. The FastAPI transport's new fixed-packet path is the bigger concern — it ungated-buffers any bytes payload as PCM, never actually paces despite the PR description, and never flushes the trailing remainder. The rename is also a quiet breaking change. Fix gating, add flush/pacing or rename honestly, and pin the protocol shapes.
